introText: Device Reminder detects when household devices start and finish and notifies you.
placeholderText: This section is configured in a later step.
typesHelp: Thresholds per device type. Built-in types cannot be renamed or removed. In count mode the values count polling ticks (see General). Pause protection (optional, 0 = off): a phase below the end threshold that starts within the first "Pause if it starts before" seconds of a run, or whose power stays below "Pause if power below", only counts as the end after "Pause hold" seconds. Usually set by learning.
recipientsHelp: Recipients receive the device messages. Assign them per device. Active-from/until limit the time window (do not disturb).
pollIntervalHelp: 1 to 600 seconds. Count-based thresholds (start/end count) count ticks of this interval.
dev_sourceInfo: Select the socket, device or alias the device is connected to. The power and switch states are detected automatically. Choose manual entry to enter the states yourself.
dev_hintNotFound: No power state was found for this source. Enter the power state manually.
dev_hintNoPattern: The source was not recognized as a socket. A single power state was used; please check it and add a switch state if needed.
dev_abortHelp: Report when the device is switched off before the run has finished.
dev_autoOffHelp: Switches the socket off after the delay below.
dev_reminderHelp: Repeats the end message until it is acknowledged.
dev_reminderAckStateHelp: Any state that changes to true acknowledges the device.
dev_abortFixedHelp: Corrects the abort detection of version 3.1.2. An abort is only reported when the switch of the device is off, so a switch must be configured. Leave off to keep the old behavior.
devicesHelp: Add, edit and operate your devices here. The same list is available in the Config Manager tab of the instance.
dm_detailsTypeUnknown: The device type does not exist (any more). Select another type in the device settings.
dm_learnInfo: The power curve was analysed. Check the values and give the new device type a name. Saving restarts the adapter instance.
rcp_volumeHelp: The volume is set for the announcement and restored afterwards.
rcp_volumeStateIdHelp: Only needed if the volume state is not found automatically (e.g. Alexa groups). Normally leave empty.
rcp_targetHelp: Choose a user or chat known to the telegram instance.
rcp_windowHelp: Messages are only sent in this time window (also across midnight). Empty = always.
rcp_priorityHelp: Priority of the target service (Pushover: -2 to 2, 2 = needs confirmation).
rcp_topicHelp: ntfy topic the message is published to.
rcp_discordHelp: Fill in at least the user name, user ID or channel ID.
rcp_messengerHelp: All installed instances of the supported messenger adapters.
rcp_echoHelp: Echo devices and groups of the chosen alexa2 instance.
rcp_testHelp: Sends a test message with the settings shown here (also before saving).
dev_enumsHelp: Assigns the device to rooms and functions (categories). Needed, for example, to show it in the Devices tab.
dm_learnSourceInfo: The power state of this device is stored by a history adapter. The adapter can derive the device type from all runs of the last 30 days instead of recording a new run.
dm_learnEvalInfo: Every run was replayed with each detection mode: runs detected correctly / runs found · mean (max) time until the end is reported. The recommended mode is preselected. Cross-check: runs that would also have been detected if that run had been missing from the history; if it is lower, learn again after more runs.
dm_learnPauseInfo: Pause protection: a long pause (e.g. soaking) only counts as the end after the hold time, so every other run reports the end quickly. 0 = off.
typeTrailerBurstTooltip: Longest drum movement after the programme in s (15-180). 0 = anti-crease filter off (3.1.2 behaviour).
typeTrailerGapTooltip: Minimum quiet time before a drum movement in s. 0 = 3 polls, at least 30 s. Shorter stops (tumbling while washing) are never held.
typeTrailerAfterTooltip: Drum movements are held only this many seconds after the start. 0 = unused.
typeTrailerBlockTooltip: Drum movements are held only after a block of at least 2 minutes whose power in its last 2 minutes is at least this value (e.g. spinning at the end). 0 = unused.
typeTrailerMaxTooltip: Length of the anti-crease phase after the end in s (900-14400, default 7200). It also ends after 20 minutes without a drum movement.
dm_autoOptimizeHelp: After every run the detection is checked against all stored runs and improved without restarting the instance. Off = values of the device type.
dm_optimizeNotifyHelp: Every change of the automatic optimisation is also sent to the recipients of the device.
dm_optTrailer_notSeparable: Not separable, end after the anti-crease phase
dm_optClearConfirm: Delete all stored runs and optimised values of this device?
dm_optSaveType: Save as new device type (restarts the instance)
dm_optInfo: The detection is checked after every run against all stored runs of all programmes. Repairs follow after one faulty run, tightenings only after at least 4 runs and 24 hours.
dm_learnTrailerInfo: Anti-crease filter: drum movements after the programme are ignored, so the end is reported when the programme finishes. 0 = off.
dm_learnTrailerNotSeparable: An anti-crease phase was found, but a phase inside a programme looks the same. The end is only reported after the anti-crease phase (never too early).
